title: Bandit Trouble
description: A carter named Oswald Pell took an arrow through the shoulder on the Elder Moor road last week and hasn't worked since - one of six attacks the guard has logged this month. The bandits camped in the northern hills aren't slowing down, and every cart that stops running is goods that don't reach Dalhurst's shelves. Someone needs to clear the camp before the road empties out entirely.

objectives.description: Find the bandit camp in the northern hills

notes: Named victim (Oswald Pell, invented for this quest only, prose colour) replaces the abstract 'innocent blood'. Bounty board quest; giver has no voice by design (board posting). Consequence stated: goods not reaching Dalhurst's shelves.
